headings.usage: Hero titles, Section headers, Book titles

assets.icons: Use lucide-react (BookOpen, Shield, Globe, ArrowRight, Mail)

hero.structure: Asymmetrical Split or Centered Typographic Behemoth

mission.content: Why it exists. Privacy, Dignity, Culture.

books.style: Vertical interactive list. Hovering a title reveals a subtle abstract cover or glow. Each book links to Amazon.
items: The Light God Wants You to See

waitlist.style: Clean, border-bottom only or glassmorphism container. No aggressive marketing copy.

steps.details: Import Playfair Display and JetBrains Mono from Google Fonts in index.css
Create the main container with 'bg-[#020408] text-white min-h-screen font-sans selection:bg-[#C5A059] selection:text-black'
Use the 'hero_bg' image with low opacity (opacity-20) mixed with a gradient overlay. Center the BANIBS acronym expansion.
Use a 2-column grid on desktop. Left: 'What is BANIBS?'. Right: The explanation text in large, readable serif font.
Create a list of links. Use 'group' hover effects. When hovering a book, dim the others. Add a subtle 'ArrowUpRight' icon.
Preserve the existing localStorage logic. Style the form to be elegant and unobtrusive.

code_snippets.hero_title_classes: text-5xl md:text-7xl font-serif font-bold tracking-tighter leading-tight
code_snippets.section_title_classes: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-[#C5A059] mb-8
code_snippets.book_link_classes: block text-2xl md:text-4xl font-serif py-6 border-b border-white/10 hover:text-[#C5A059] hover:pl-4 transition-all duration-300 flex justify-between items-center group

universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for text.
Ensure all interactive elements have hover states.
No generic stock photos of people shaking hands.
